Below, a female character in a pink sailor-style uniform with rabbit ears is shown from behind, walking in a dark, dusty Japanese house. A monster lurks nearby. (2) The character runs towards a sliding wooden door, pursued by a monster. The man above reacts with animated facial expressions. The character attempts to interact with the door but is repeatedly struck by a fiery creature. (3) A digital map overlay briefly covers the game view, showing a floor plan with red arrows. The video then cuts back to the character running through hallways as a giant hand reaches through a door to attack her. (4) The character is seen repeatedly being hit by the monster's arm coming through the gap in the door frame. The man in the window laughs and points at the screen. (5) A close-up shows the character's blood-soaked and burned back. The man continues his commentary with varied hand gestures, focusing on the visual damage to the avatar.
